title: LLM Hint Factory programming task sequence
summary: Novice programmers complete a pre-test, three programming tasks, and a post-test while requesting four levels of GPT-generated hints. Students can move from orientation and instrumental guidance to worked examples and exact next-step code when they need more support.

sources.title: Exploring How Multiple Levels of GPT-Generated Programming Hints Support or Disappoint Novices
sources.evidence_quote: We conducted a user study with 12 novice programming learners to complete three programming learning tasks with pre- and post-test using the LLM Hint Factory.
